_comment: AgentSpec for a DOPPELGANGER world agent. Subagents ON (the adversarial investigation is delegated to one) and sandbox ON (for exploratory reproducers; the backend drives this flag from BRANCHPOINT_TRUEFORGE_SANDBOX_ENABLED, and it is the only spec that may ever set it). The sandbox buys TrueForge's built-in `exec` and nothing else: enable_tools is identical whether it is on or off, and everything the sandbox produces is recorded machine_verifiable=false. Only read-only world-inspection tools are enabled, by literal name — no mutation tool is reachable from this session at all.
